title: Tatami Room Tiling Puzzle
tagline: Fill the room. Never let four corners meet.
description: Lay woven straw mats across a Japanese-style room so that no point touches the corners of four different mats. Every room has exactly one solution, with hints that teach, a daily puzzle and four seasons. Portrait or landscape, phone or tablet.
howToPlay: Cover every square of the room using all the mats you are given.
Pick a full or half mat, then tap a square or drag across two.
Never let the corners of four different mats meet at one point.
Tap the lamp for a hint: where to look, then why it works.
Watch and Learn lays a whole room and explains every mat.
